summary: TagService migration from manual implementation to generated TagsService from drizzle-sync is correctly implemented. The manual tag-service.ts properly extends the generated TagsService and preserves the custom getCustomerCount method. All imports resolve correctly.

findings.title: Generated TagsService follows BaseService pattern
findings.description: The generated TagsService class (lines ~581-719 of services.ts) correctly extends BaseService, implements getEntityType() returning 'tags', implements getEntityPrefix() returning 'tag', and queues sync operations in create/update/delete methods.

findings.title: Manual extension preserves custom method
findings.description: TagService extends TagsService and preserves the getCustomerCount(tagId) method that queries the customerTags table. Input types are re-exported as type aliases for backward compatibility.

findings.title: All imports resolve correctly
findings.description: service-provider.tsx imports TagService from tag-service.ts. use-tags.ts imports CreateTagInput/UpdateTagInput from tag-service.ts. useTagService() hook returns TagService instance.

findings.title: Proper separation of generated vs custom code
findings.description: Generated CRUD lives in services.ts (drizzle-sync output). Custom business logic (getCustomerCount) lives in tag-service.ts extension. This follows the intended architecture pattern.

findings.title: Duplicate import blocks in generated services.ts
findings.description: The generated services.ts file contains duplicate import blocks (each service class repeats the same imports). This is a pre-existing generator bug that was fixed in feature 'fix-duplicate-imports-service-generator' (commit 78d96ac). The tags service section is affected but this is not introduced by this feature.

findings.title: customerCount property missing from Tag type
findings.description: The tags route (_protected.config.tags.tsx:129-130) references tag.customerCount but the Tag type from @avileo/shared does not have this property. This is a pre-existing issue unrelated to the tag service migration - the previous manual implementation also returned Tag[] from findByBusiness() which lacks customerCount.

private static readonly ENTITY_TYPE: EntityType = 'tags' at services.ts:602
private static readonly ID_PREFIX = 'tag' at services.ts:603
await this.queueSync('update', id, input) at services.ts:679

async getCustomerCount(tagId: string): Promise<number> at tag-service.ts:45-52
export type CreateTagInput = CreateTagsInput at tag-service.ts:18
export function useTagService(): TagService at service-provider.tsx:344

typecheck.note: Typecheck shows 125+ pre-existing errors unrelated to tag migration. No new tag-specific type errors introduced by this feature. The customerCount type error in tags route is pre-existing.

recommendations: Consider enriching the Tag type with customerCount in findByBusiness() by joining with customer_tags table, or update the route to call getCustomerCount separately
The duplicate imports in generated services.ts are fixed by feature fix-duplicate-imports-service-generator (commit 78d96ac)
